eyebrow: A social network for real people
heroDescription: Rediscover real conversations, memorable moments, and the people who make ordinary days feel extraordinary.

postAlt: Breakfast with orange juice and fresh fruit
friendsAlt: A group of friends enjoying a conversation
featureFeedTitle: A feed with a finish line
featureFeedDescription: No endless scrolling. Once you have caught up on what matters, Orange reminds you to get back to living.
featureGroupsDescription: Create a circle for each group of friends. Share naturally, without performing for a crowd.
featureAttentionDescription: No ads following you around. No addictive algorithms. Your data and your time belong to you.
beliefTitle: Social media should make you feel
beliefDescription: That is why Orange starts with one question: what is actually good for people?
quote: I came to Orange to see what my friends were up to — and left with plans for the weekend.
communityDescription: From potters in Hoi An to Sunday morning running clubs, Orange is being shaped by small communities full of life.
